text:
Customer payment data must be encrypted at rest using AES-256. Encryption keys are managed in the approved key management service.

Key rotation occurs at least annually, and rotation events are logged.
Past review of a ledger change. Reviewers asked how reconciliation failures are detected. Approved control: a daily reconciliation job with alerting to the finance operations queue.
Personal data may be retained only for the period defined in the retention schedule. Retention exceptions require privacy office approval.
Restricted review: details of an incident response exercise. Visible only to the security team.
